name: Fraction Pizza
description: Cut pizzas and pies and serve slices: halves and quarters, equal fractions, adding slices, fractions on a number line, then mixed numbers, multiplying and dividing fractions, percents, decimals, rates and probability.

about.concept: Fractions as parts of a whole and as positions on a line. Cutting and serving slices makes equal parts, equivalent fractions and adding fractions concrete before they are written.
about.progression: Cutting a pizza into equal pieces comes first, then serving halves, quarters, thirds, sixths and eighths, naming and matching equal fractions, adding slices, placing fractions on a number line and comparing them. The upper rungs re-slice pizzas for equivalent fractions and unlike denominators, then cover mixed numbers, a fraction of a group, multiplying and dividing fractions, percents, decimals, proportional orders and unit rates, and the chance of a random slice in simplest form.
lifeSkills: Explaining why two amounts are the same
